page.overview:
Who is Zelina Vega?

Thea Megan Trinidad Büdgen (born December 27, 1990) is an American professional wrestler and actress of Puerto Rican descent. In Street Fighter 6 she is one of the available in-game commentators. She also cosplayed as Juri in WWE Royal Rumble 2023, at the "Women's Royal Rumble" match where she emulated some of Juri's moves.

She is currently signed to WWE, where she performs on the SmackDown brand under the ring name Zelina Vega and is a former WWE Women's Tag Team and WWE Women's United States Champion, and the winner of the 2021 Queen's Crown tournament. Trinidad is the first of just four women to hold the women's world tag team championships of both WWE and Impact Wrestling (the two others being Cassie Lee, Jessie McKay, and Chelsea Green).

Trinidad is also known for her time in Total Nonstop Action Wrestling as Rosita, where she was a one-time TNA Knockouts Tag Team Champion with Sarita, and for various independent promotions under her real name. She debuted on WWE's NXT brand in 2017 under the ring name Zelina Vega, where she predominantly served as the manager of Andrade "Cien" Almas. WWE released Trinidad in November 2020, but re-signed her less than six months later. Trinidad's ring name was changed to Queen Zelina after her Queen's Crown tournament win.

Trinidad portrayed fellow professional wrestler AJ Lee in the 2019 biographical film Fighting with My Family.
